relationships.evidence: ÖKOBAUDAT admission principles and validation profiles require EN 15804-aligned EPD data.
relationships.constraints: National profile requirements extend the standard.
relationships.validation_question: Separate standard conformance from ÖKOBAUDAT-specific admission rules.

relationships.evidence: EN 15804 provides construction-sector core PCR rules within the Type III EPD framework governed by ISO 14025.
relationships.constraints: Programme transition to ISO 14025:2026 may not be immediate.

relationships.evidence: INIES FDES content is governed by NF EN 15804 and its national supplement.
relationships.constraints: French programme rules extend the European standard.

relationships.evidence: LCAx validation examples include checking EPD conformance to EN 15804+A2.
relationships.constraints: A custom rule is not formal certification.

relationships.evidence: ICE supplies embodied-carbon factors for building materials, while EN 15804 governs EPD rules.
relationships.constraints: ICE factors are literature-based and should not be treated as verified EN 15804 EPDs.
relationships.validation_question: Keep generic factors separate from product declarations.

relationships.evidence: EPDItaly construction declarations follow EN 15804 programme rules.
relationships.constraints: Other product categories and programme transitions may use different rule sets.
relationships.validation_question: Record the applicable PCR and EN 15804 edition per declaration.
